name: print-social-navy-and-pale-blue-fintech-ad-pair-with-laurel-badge
title: Two portrait ads: card-over-eye in navy with #1 laurel badge, and 'Move smarter' with a terminal
whatItIs: A pair of rounded ads. The left: navy background with a woman in a navy sweater holding a bank card over one eye, the logo, a white laurel wreath with '#1 4.9' and an Explore button. The right: pale blue with a big navy 'Move smarter.' (italic serif second word) beside a woman using a card terminal.
whatItMeans: Playful yet credible; the card-over-eye pose is memorable and the laurel adds proof.
techniques: Colour the wardrobe like the background.
Use a laurel badge as social proof.
Mix sans and italic serif in a headline.
Crop tightly on props like terminals.

vocabulary.definition: A wreath around a rating or rank.
A gesture such as covering an eye with a card.
